title: Switching to tuba for records
summary: Braud explains he played tuba on some records such as the Mooch while preferring string bass.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Yeah. What year were you born?
So, I was wondering, how come you changed to tuba for a while?

Well, I tried. I didn't, I wasn't crazy about the tuba, but there was a few records that they wanted to make on tuba, and I could play tuba. It was very easy for me. And I did a pretty good job. I guess you heard the mooch. I can't give you anything but love. Black and tan? Well, that was tuba. No, no. Black and tan was that big tone from that bass. That's what you heard. That's right. That's the old London band when they first came out. Yeah. Great.
